purpose: Restore the GitHub Actions pinning ratchet, which has been failing closed on main since #4648 and therefore fails the 'Conservative provenance, licenses & SBOM baseline' job on every pull request. #4648 added two actions/checkout references by floating tag to platform-v7-autopilot-guard.yml, taking the floating count from the baseline ceiling of 1028 to 1030. verify-action-pinning.mjs exits 1 before the evidence-generating steps run, so artifacts/ip-clean-room is never created and the IP evidence verification cascades into failure.
requiredInvariants: The baseline ceiling is NOT raised. Raising it to match the observed count would weaken a security gate to force green, which is forbidden; the ratchet only moves toward tightening.

The references are pinned to 11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262, the exact commit SHA this repository already uses for actions/checkout in 10 other places. No new supply-chain decision is introduced and no version is changed.
Only platform-v7-autopilot-guard.yml is touched. No other workflow, no gate logic, and no application code.
The cause was established by bisecting verify-action-pinning.mjs across the last 12 commits of main, not inferred: the count rises from 1028 to 1030 exactly at #4648.
It was confirmed not to be the current work's doing: the verifier gives the identical exit 1 and the identical 1030 on clean origin/main.
No production, REG.RU, DNS or database mutation.
acceptance: The floating count returns to 1027, at or below the untouched ceiling of 1028.
grep finds no remaining actions/checkout floating-tag reference in platform-v7-autopilot-guard.yml.
The 'Conservative provenance, licenses & SBOM baseline' job reaches its evidence-generation steps instead of exiting before them.
